blockers: At native 1x, the face collapses into a pale mask with bright horizontal eyes beneath a helmet-like hair cap; brows, nose, mouth, and facial planes are not readable.
The front silhouette is a narrow, symmetrical humanoid with generic raised arms. The corset, collar, hands, rapier hilt, and brass ornaments do not create a distinctive contour.
The navy upper body merges into the hair and dark background, while the white lower garment and orange legs read as disconnected pieces with unclear material semantics.
The 16-frame idle strip is effectively static at native scale. Breathing, tension, and controlled settling are too subtle to register as animation.
The locomotion cycles use a rigid upright torso with weak hip drop and almost no shoulder counter-rotation. The result is mannequin-like and risks ice-skating despite the technically stable anchor.
Feet are too small and narrow to communicate load. The cycles lack a convincing locked planted phase, clear toe-off, and visible weight transfer.
The signature gesture is mostly an isolated thin sword arc. There is no strong anticipation, torso counter-action, wrist control, overshoot, recoil, or settle.
Secondary motion is absent: hair, collar, garment edges, brass details, and the rapier do not provide delayed or follow-through motion.
In oblique locomotion views, the hand-hilt-blade junction is only a few pixels and can read as a detached line rather than a weapon held by the character.
high_value_changes: Redesign the base sprite specifically for native 1x: simplify the hair into a readable asymmetric mass, give the face a stronger brow and mouth structure, enlarge the hand and rapier-hilt read, and create clearer negative spaces around the arms and waist.
Clarify the material hierarchy by separating hair, high collar, corset, lower garment, legs, and boots through value and hue rather than relying on tiny brass accents.
Reauthor all walk cycles around explicit contact, down, passing, and up poses with a locked planted sole, toe compression, knee flexion, hip transfer, and visible shoulder/hip counter-rotation.
Rebuild the signature gesture as a restrained rapier salute with a preparatory set, deliberate arm lead, torso and head response, blade overshoot, and a controlled return settle.
Add restrained secondary motion to hair, collar, garment panels, brass ornaments, and the rapier so the character feels contained rather than frozen.
Audit every frame at 1x on both dark and light backgrounds, especially the face, feet, hand-hilt connection, and sword blade.
optional_notes: The exact 112.6px standing height and 0.0px anchor drift satisfy the hard scale and placement constraints, but technical compliance does not compensate for weak contact readability.
The 8-direction coverage is structurally complete, yet directional coverage currently exposes the same rigid walk template rather than eight convincing views of a deliberate character.
strongest_improvements: Ground anchoring is stable with 0.0px measured drift.
The blue, white, ochre, and skin value groups preserve a basic full-body read on light inspection backgrounds.
The rapier-raise event is visible as a broad motion arc in the gesture strip, providing a usable foundation for a more fully authored signature action.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Redesign the base Celina sprite for unmistakable native-1x readability before adding more animation: establish an asymmetric silhouette with a readable face, hands, feet, collar, corset, and connected rapier hilt.
